context_for_next_testing_agent: Recording feature fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/meetings/{id}/recording/upload (file upload to Object Storage), POST /api/meetings/{id}/recording/stop (creates metadata), GET /api/meetings/{id}/recording/play/{filename} (serves file). Frontend RecordingsPage shows 'Abspielen' for recordings with URL, 'Keine Datei' for those without. Video player uses native HTML5 <video>. MediaRecorder client-side capture cannot be tested in Playwright (no camera/mic). Known recording with URL: meet_8afa2e15ca with file 6d03ce5d.webm. Email sending is MOCKED.

notes: The recording feature bug fix is working correctly. The previous issue was that recordings only created metadata without actual media capture. Now the client-side MediaRecorder captures video/audio during meetings, uploads to Object Storage via POST /api/meetings/{id}/recording/upload, and recordings are playable on the Recordings page.
